truthAudit.Summary: Truth audit of Run 2 against 20 known vulnerabilities (SC-V3-001 through SC-V3-020). Run 2 correctly detected 12 of 20 vulnerabilities (found_full): SC-V3-001, 002, 003, 004, 005, 006, 009, 010, 011, 012, 013, and 020. Run 2 missed 8 vulnerabilities: SC-V3-007 (logic bomb), 008 (path traversal), 014 (persistent auth state), 015 (unhandled exception), 016 (integer underflow), 017 (unbounded recursion), 018 (data race), and 019 (TOCTOU). Severity corrections were recorded for 6 findings (High to Critical, Medium to High, Low to Medium). CWE corrections were recorded for 4 findings (CWE-121 to CWE-120/CWE-121, CWE-121 to CWE-122, CWE-676 to CWE-362, CWE-78 to CWE-377). No false positives were identified among the 14 previous findings.

Items.Notes: Run 2 finding 'Format String Vulnerability in log_debug_message' (CWE-134) correctly identified the format-string injection where printf uses runtime_log_format() output as the format string with user_input as an argument. Evidence quotes match anchors log_format, runtime_log_format, and printf(active_format.c_str(), user_input). Severity was listed as High; truth is Critical (correction recorded separately).

Run 2 finding 'Integer Overflow in factorial function' (CWE-190) correctly identified the integer overflow in the factorial computation where result *= i has no overflow check. Evidence quotes match anchors result *= i and fact lambda. Severity was listed as Medium; truth is High (correction recorded separately).

Run 2 finding 'Use-After-Free in stage_deferred_history_flush' (CWE-416, Critical) correctly identified the use-after-free where scratch allocated from g_memory_pool is captured by an enqueued lambda that may execute after memory::g_memory_pool.cleanup() frees all pool blocks. Evidence quotes match anchors stage_deferred_history_flush, memory::g_memory_pool.cleanup, sleep_for, and scratch.

Items.Notes: Run 2 finding 'Command Injection in ConfigLoader::validate_config' (CWE-78) correctly identified the command injection via system() with validator_cmd + " " + config_file. Evidence quotes match anchors validator_cmd + " " + config_file, system(command.c_str()), and admin validate context. Severity was listed as High; truth is Critical (correction recorded separately).

Run 2 finding 'Buffer Overflow in evaluate_expression' (CWE-121, High) correctly identified the stack buffer overflow via strcpy(input_buffer_, ...) when expression.length() >= sizeof(input_buffer_), and finding 'Off-by-One Buffer Overflow in safe_string_copy' covered the dest[src_len] / src_len > dest_size anchors. Evidence matches anchors strcpy(input_buffer_, dest[src_len], and src_len > dest_size. CWE was listed as CWE-121; truth is CWE-120/CWE-121 (correction recorded separately).

Items.Notes: Run 2 finding 'Race Condition in ThreadSafeCounter::increment' (CWE-362, Medium) correctly identified the race condition where old_value = value_ is read outside the lock, then value_ = old_value + 1 overwrites after lock acquisition. Evidence quotes match anchors old_value = value_, lock_guard, and value_ = old_value + 1. The volatile long long anchor was not explicitly quoted but the vulnerability was correctly identified via the other anchors.

Run 2 did not contain a finding for the logic bomb in authentication. The source code at lines 592-598 shows login_attempts_ > 5 combined with EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE bypassing authentication (authenticated_ = true). This vulnerability (CWE-511, High) was not detected or mentioned in any of the 14 previous findings.

Run 2 did not contain a finding for path traversal in configuration loading. The source code at lines 543-544 shows load_config concatenating config_dir_ + filename without sanitization, enabling path traversal (CWE-22, Medium). This was not detected in the 14 previous findings.

Run 2 finding 'Buffer Overflow in ExpressionParser::parse' (CWE-121, High) correctly identified the heap buffer overflow via strcpy(expression_buffer_, expr_str.c_str()) where expression_buffer_ is allocated with buffer_size_ = 256 from the memory pool. Evidence matches anchors buffer_size_ = 256 and strcpy(expression_buffer_. schedule_expression_analysis creates the parser and calls parse. Severity was listed as High; truth is Critical (correction recorded separately). CWE was listed as CWE-121; truth is CWE-122 (correction recorded separately).

Run 2 finding 'Hardcoded Admin Secret' (CWE-798, High) correctly identified the hardcoded administrator credentials ADMIN_SECRET = "SC_ENT_2025_AUTH" in the config::security namespace. Evidence quotes match anchors ADMIN_SECRET and SC_ENT_2025_AUTH.

Run 2 finding 'Weak Session Token Generation' (CWE-338) correctly identified the weak PRNG for session tokens using std::mt19937 with uniform_int_distribution(1000, 9999). Evidence quotes match anchors std::mt19937, uniform_int_distribution, and 1000, 9999. Severity was listed as Medium; truth is High (correction recorded separately).

Items.Notes: Run 2 finding 'Non-thread-safe localtime usage' (CWE-676, Low) correctly identified the thread-unsafe timestamp cache using static std::tm cached_time with localtime() and cached_time = *local_time. Evidence quotes match anchors static std::tm cached_time, localtime, and cached_time = *local_time. Severity was listed as Low; truth is Medium (correction recorded separately). CWE was listed as CWE-676; truth is CWE-362 (correction recorded separately).

Run 2 finding 'Command Injection in append_override_audit_event' (CWE-78, Medium) correctly identified the vulnerable code in append_override_audit_event using TEMP/TMPDIR environment variables, supercalc_emergency.log file path, and system(command.c_str()). Evidence quotes match anchors TEMP, TMPDIR, supercalc_emergency.log, and system(command.c_str()). The previous answer classified it as CWE-78 (command injection); truth classifies it as CWE-377 (insecure temporary file handling) (correction recorded separately).

Run 2 did not contain a finding for persistent authentication state. The source code shows authenticated_, login_attempts_, and session_token_ in the AdminConsole class (lines 578-582) remaining in memory after authentication, enabling session persistence attacks (CWE-613, Medium). This was not detected in the 14 previous findings.

Run 2 did not contain a finding for unhandled exception in variable parsing. The source code at line 729 shows std::stod(tokens[3]) in handle_variable_command which can throw std::out_of_range or std::invalid_argument exceptions (CWE-754, Low). This was not detected in the 14 previous findings.

Run 2 did not contain a finding for integer underflow in memory-pool block split. The source code at line 133 shows size_t remaining = previous_size - size - SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES; which can underflow if previous_size is small (CWE-191, Critical). This was not detected in the 14 previous findings.

Run 2 did not contain a finding for unbounded recursion in the parser. The source code shows parse_expression calls parse_factor which calls parse_expression recursively on PAREN_OPEN tokens (lines 426-430) without depth checking (CWE-674, High). This was not detected in the 14 previous findings.

Run 2 did not contain a finding for data race in result cache. The source code shows result_cache_ accessed in evaluate_cached (lines 445-452) without acquiring cache_mutex_, while schedule_expression_analysis enqueues work via thread_pool_ (line 808) that calls evaluate_cached, creating a data race (CWE-362, Medium). This was not detected in the 14 previous findings.

Run 2 did not contain a finding for TOCTOU in config loading. The source code at lines 544-546 shows std::filesystem::exists(full_path) followed by std::this_thread::sleep_for and then std::ifstream file(full_path), creating a time-of-check to time-of-use race (CWE-367, Medium). This was not detected in the 14 previous findings.

Run 2 finding 'Division by Zero in calculate_route_score' (CWE-369, Low) correctly identified the integer division by zero when token_length is 0 in calculate_route_score. Evidence quotes match anchors calculate_route_score, token_length, and 100 / static_cast<int>(token_length).
